# MIDI triggers

## MIDI Message

Runs when a MIDI device (a music keyboard, pad controller or mixer) sends a message, such as a key press or a knob turn. Turns music gear into hotkeys.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Device** | Which MIDI keyboard or device. Use the name you gave it in the MIDI page. Type Any to react to every device. Starts as: `Any`. |
| **Event** | The name of a listener you set up in the MIDI page, for example one for a pad or a knob. Type Any to react to every message from the device. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%eventName%` | The name of the listener that matched |
| `%name%` | The name you gave the device |
| `%commandCode%` | The kind of message, like NoteOn or ControlChange |
| `%channel%` | The MIDI channel, 1 to 16 |
| `%noteNumber%` | For notes: the note number, 0 to 127 |
| `%noteName%` | For notes: the note name, like "C4" |
| `%velocity%` | For notes: how hard the key was hit, 0 to 127 |
| `%controllerNumber%` | For knobs and sliders: which control, 0 to 127 |
| `%value%` | The value: velocity, knob position, or pitch bend |
| `%valueNormal%` | The same value as a number from 0 to 1 |

<small>Type id: `midi.message`</small>
